Pull request discussion is limited to the author, requested reviewers, and maintainers. Everyone else: please start a thread in GitHub Discussions and link the pull request.
files.docs/engineering-policy.md:
# Fernhill Labs engineering policy

Applies to every repository in the fernhill-labs organization.

## Review conversations

Only the reviewer who opened a review conversation resolves it. Authors and maintainers must not resolve other people's conversations. Exceptions require approval from an organization owner.
files.src/ledger/cli.py:
import argparse
import csv
import sys
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from ledger.export import export_csv


def output_path(out):
    """Normalize --out to a POSIX path under its parent directory."""
    path = PurePosixPath(out.replace("\\", "/"))
    return str(path.parent / out)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="ledger")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    export = commands.add_parser("export")
    export.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    with open(output_path(args.out), "w", newline="") as out:
        export_csv(csv.reader(sys.stdin), out)
